digest.component_or_area: code quality remediation (CI reliability, docs, complexity/typing ratchets)
propositions: CI test_opcert_service_app flake on Python 3.11 xdist workers is root-caused to a pytest-xdist teardown race under host contention, benign post-results noise.
User-facing assignee documentation example must teach a Jira-resolvable identity consistent with docs/config.md.
Three near-cap modules (structured_run, compact, event_append) must be split by responsibility/layer to reach ≤500/≤500/≤640 LOC targets while preserving public import paths.

Graph loader/traversal duplication across blocker subsystem (_find_direct_blockers, _get_all_blocked_by, check_cycle_at_level, detect_newly_unblocked) must be centralized via load_indexed_states and shared BFS skeleton to drop CCN below 15 threshold.
attest package must pass mypy --disallow-untyped-defs type checking.
